steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample based on the extraction type.

substeps.instruction: For HA filter extraction: Thaw the sample on ice.
For BCoV/BRSV extraction (in duplicate): Add 5 µL of BCoV/BRSV solution to a 2-mL tube containing 500 µL MWA1, vortex for 15 seconds (speed 7/10), and flash freeze the tube.
For Direct extraction: Add 150 µL of wastewater to a 2-mL tube containing 100 µL CTAB, vortex for 15 seconds (speed 7/10), and flash freeze the tube.

steps.title: Bead Beating (HA Filter Only)
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical disruption for HA filter extraction samples using a Mini-Beadbeater-16 (BioSpec, 607, 1 speed).

substeps.instruction: Place the 2-mL tubes in the bead beater.
Bead beat for 00:02:30, starting the timer when the beads start to be loose in the tubes.
Cooldown the samples on ice for 00:05:00.
Repeat the bead beating and cooldown process once.

steps.title: Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples to separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (150,000 rpm) for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Supernatant Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to the Lysis/Bind plate based on the extraction type.

substeps.instruction: For HA filter extraction: Transfer 400 µL of supernatant.
For BCoV/BRSV/Direct extraction: Transfer all supernatant.

steps.title: Sample Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the purified nucleic acids and store as needed.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the purified sample from the Elution plate to microcentrifuge tubes.
Store RNA extract in RNase-free water at -80ºC for up to 1 year.
